requires: explicit selected_gcs_archives list of exact project_scope/bucket/object/generation/format tuples
admission.scope: Every exact project_scope explicitly present in collector.scopes; native CRM v3 number/projectId and bucket.projectNumber binding mandatory
admission.duplicates: Reject same native object tuple even with different formats
admission.default_off: No opt-in or missing named kind performs zero extra object calls and zero scanner calls
admission.root_combined_selection_proposal: At most ten text+archive targets combined at intake; existing runtime compressed/call/time budgets are already shared across both kinds

queries: projection=noAcl and minimal fields for metadata
before_media: existing CRM v3 numeric name+projectId and native bucket.projectNumber binding
native_read.integrity: Shared reader refuses redirects/errors without reading their bodies; requires exact generation header, Content-Length matching metadata and complete bytes, matching media MIME, no Content-Range and no nonidentity Content-Encoding; closes every response
native_read.transport: Uses unchanged text _read with real session/credentials/cancellation/lock/call/deadline budgets and safe request evidence; never JSON media cache
native_read.provenance: collection_pages attaches both native metadata and media request IDs through normal GCPCollector.envelope

bounds.ratio_formula: ZIP inherited max(1024,compressed_member_bytes*200); gzip cap min(remaining expanded cap,max(1024,compressed_archive_bytes*200))
bounds.failure_charging: Failed parses consume full reserved expanded/member allowance; no reset per scope, page or malformed archive
bounds.expansion_accounting: ZIP actual file bytes; tar decompressed container bytes including headers/padding

parser_reuse.method: FunctionType reuses audited parser code with a private per-call copy of globals binding GCP caps and inspect_member callback; original AWS globals unchanged
parser_reuse.facade: Only check_deadline is supplied, delegating to shared GCP cancellation/deadline

supported_coverage: Complete selected ZIP/tar/tar.gz containing at least one regular UTF8 text file, with both offline detectors complete for every regular member; directories counted but not scanned. A regular zero-byte file can be a complete bounded observation.
unsupported_unknown: symlink/hardlink/device or special tar metadata members
encrypted/unsupported ZIP compression and ZIP64 beyond bounds
nested archives and known binary member suffixes
directory-only/empty container without regular-file detector coverage
MIME/octet-stream mismatch, customer encryption or HTTP transcoding

finding_contract.desired_state: Selected Cloud Storage archive has no detected secrets
positive_evidence: A likely secret was detected in a text member of an explicitly selected Cloud Storage archive.
The value is hidden; detection did not validate the credential.
finding_contract.negative: Both offline detectors completed on every regular text member of the complete selected archive without finding a supported secret.
finding_contract.unknown: Selected archive scanning is disabled, incomplete, unreadable or unsupported; secret absence could not be assessed.
finding_contract.partial: Any unsupported member or incomplete parse makes whole archive UNKNOWN; partial parser observations are not emitted as complete evidence.
finding_contract.location: Opaque selected-archive identity and archive.member-N ordinal plus optional line; raw object/member filenames never persist
finding_contract.deduplication: Existing process-keyed exact-value HMAC and engine merge yield one hidden finding per value across tools, files, archives and services; cross-process/cross-run merge not guaranteed

tests.installed_detector_cases: Six native pipeline ZIP/tar/tar.gz positive/negative cases plus shared-value files/archives/Function test
mocked_boundary_cases: actual unchanged CRM v3 scope_jobs/bucket inventory through proposed dependent job
